title: System Log: PLC-02 Program Backup Verification

lines.msg: Program comparison initiated for PLC-02 (revision 3.2) against backup on MBW-BKP-01
Source: MBW-BKP-01 (10.73.20.60) — PLC-02 program version 03/2025 (pre-08/2025 flow-pacing update)
Mismatch detected: 08/2025 flow-pacing logic not present in backup. This logic was implemented on 08/15/2025 and is not stored on MBW-BKP-01.
Verification failed: backup program does not contain the latest flow-pacing revision (08/2025). Restoration from backup would result in loss of critical control logic.
Action required: Full on-site re-image of PLC-02 by Kessler Controls is mandatory. Do not attempt remote reload. Verify program integrity post-reimage with WQ and IC.

instructorNote: This inject confirms the critical gap in the backup strategy. The TL must now validate that the 08/2025 logic cannot be restored from any source, forcing a full on-site re-image. Watch for any attempt to proceed with a remote reload.
